Export function isConditionOnlyProperty(propKey: string, propSchema: JsonObject, options?: { depKey?: string; baseProperties?: JsonObject; earlierStepKeys?: Set<string> }): boolean that returns true when options?.depKey === propKey, or 'not' in propSchema, or 'const' in propSchema, or (!('type' in propSchema) && !('title' in propSchema) && !('ui:field' in propSchema) && !('ui:widget' in propSchema) && !('properties' in propSchema) && !('items' in propSchema)), or (Boolean(options?.earlierStepKeys?.has(propKey)) && !(options?.baseProperties && propKey in options.baseProperties) && 'enum' in propSchema && !('title' in propSchema)), and false otherwise.
4. Define helper hasDependencyValue(val: JsonValue | undefined): boolean returning val !== undefined && val !== null && val !== false && val !== '' && (!Array.isArray(val) || val.length > 0).

5. Define helper matchesPropertyCondition(propKey: string, propCond: JsonObject, data: JsonObject, booleanKeys: Set<string>): boolean that evaluates val = data[propKey] with isBooleanProp = booleanKeys.has(propKey) and effectiveVal = val === undefined && isBooleanProp ? false : val: handle propCond.not by negation (returning true if only 'not'/'type' keys exist and inner condition is false), propCond.allOf/anyOf/oneOf recursively, propCond.const via lodash isEqual(effectiveVal, propCond.const), propCond.enum via effectiveVal !== undefined && propCond.enum.some(item => isEqual(effectiveVal, item)), nested propCond.properties/required via isObject(effectiveVal) && matchesCondition(propCond, effectiveVal, booleanKeys), and any remaining JSON Schema keywords by returning val !== undefined && new JSONSchema({ type: 'object', properties: { [propKey]: propCond }, required: [propKey] }).validate({ [propKey]: effectiveVal }).length === 0.

6. Define helper matchesCondition(cond: JsonObject, data: JsonObject, booleanKeys: Set<string>): boolean that checks cond.not, cond.allOf, cond.anyOf, cond.oneOf, cond.required (every required key not in cond.properties must satisfy hasDependencyValue(data[reqKey])), and cond.properties (every object entry must satisfy matchesPropertyCondition).

7. Export function resolveConditionalSchema(schema: JsonObject, formData: JsonObject, options?: ResolveSchemaOptions): JsonObject that clones schema, populates effectiveData with defined values from formData plus default values from schema.properties when formData[k] === undefined, tracks booleanKeys for type === 'boolean' properties, and resolves allOf, if/then/else, dependencies (array required list when hasDependencyValue, or object dependency with oneOf/anyOf/allOf/if/properties), and conditional top-level oneOf/anyOf (where at least one branch has if or a property matching isConditionOnlyProperty).

8. 9. Export function collectAllSchemaPropertyKeys(schema: JsonObject, earlierStepKeys?: Set<string>, depKey?: string): Set<string> that collects all non-condition property keys (where !isConditionOnlyProperty) across schema.properties, schema.then, schema.else, schema.allOf, schema.oneOf, schema.anyOf, and schema.dependencies.
